name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx, creates three static virtual hosts, redirects HTTP to HTTPS, generates development self-signed certificates, and applies host and web security controls.

name: cache
description: Configures Memcached and Redis services, including Redis authentication and listener settings, and applies a custom post-configuration workaround to the generated Redis configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, checks out and configures the FastAPI tutorial application, provisions its database and user, and runs Uvicorn through systemd.
